pages.text: Modules go in the side panel of the hive window. The hive's tier decides how many slots are open.$(br2)One module of each kind per hive, and the Mutagen and the Gene Stabilizer can't be used together.

$(li)$(l)Lantern$(): lights up the area around you; bees work day and night.$(li)$(l)Canopy$(): work in the rain.$(li)$(l)Artificial Sun$(): work underground.$(li)$(l)Climate Stabilizer$(): ignore the biome's climate.
pages.title: Where & When

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Booster$(): +25% production.$(li)$(l)Longevity$(): the queen lives twice as long.$(li)$(l)Mutagen$(): double mutation chance.$(li)$(l)Gene Stabilizer$(): no mutations.$(li)$(l)Collector$(): products go straight into your inventory.
pages.title: How & What

pages.text: Every module is propolis, beeswax and one key item; stronger modules need rarer propolis.
